decisions.title: Pause dp-dev when idle
decisions.risk: Quarter-start training must stay available.
decisions.assumption: Pause outside required windows only.

decisions.title: Pause dp-dev and move to Zurich
decisions.risk: Move only if operations accept CH hosting.
decisions.assumption: CH is available and no extra downtime is planned.

decisions.title: Pause dp-prod when idle
decisions.risk: Could clash with close, ETL, refresh, and export windows.
decisions.assumption: Ops confirms safe pause rules around all closing jobs.

decisions.title: Run gpu-ml on demand
decisions.risk: Quarterly training days must still run uninterrupted.
decisions.assumption: Training schedule is preserved.

decisions.title: Run gpu-ml on demand in Zurich
decisions.risk: Move only if the service owner accepts CH hosting.
decisions.assumption: CH hosting is available and operationally acceptable.

decisions.title: Decommission forgotten servers
decisions.risk: Owner sign-off and data retention checks needed.
decisions.assumption: Systems are truly unused and can be removed safely.

decisions.title: Run test servers office-hours only
decisions.risk: Some teams may need off-hours access.
decisions.assumption: Only noncritical test/QA loads can pause outside office hours.

decisions.title: Rightsize vm-test after go-live
decisions.risk: Capacity might be too tight before project end.
decisions.assumption: Scale-back happens only after the enlarged project phase ends.

decisions.title: Rightsize vm-test and move to Zurich
decisions.risk: Needs owner approval and migration window.
decisions.assumption: Provider offers Zurich for this VM and scale-back is allowed.

decisions.title: Move vm-test to Zurich
decisions.risk: Requires production-style change approval.
decisions.assumption: Only the electricity mix changes; service stays available.

decisions.title: Move cicd to Zurich
decisions.risk: Needs ops sign-off; migration can affect builds.
decisions.assumption: Only grid changes; service stays available.

decisions.title: Move st-backup to Zurich
decisions.risk: Backup windows and retention must stay intact.
decisions.assumption: Data remains kept; only hosting region changes.

decisions.title: Draft texts on small model
decisions.risk: Quality and tone need business approval.
decisions.assumption: Default routing only; department licensing unchanged.

decisions.title: Summarise on small model
decisions.risk: Summaries may lose nuance on harder inputs.
decisions.assumption: Default routing only; department licensing unchanged.

decisions.title: Translate on small model
decisions.risk: Terminology quality may drop for legal text.
decisions.assumption: Default routing only; department licensing unchanged.

decisions.title: Classify on small model
decisions.risk: Needs marketing acceptance for edge cases.
decisions.assumption: Only default changes; manual override remains.

decisions.title: Remove unread tables
decisions.risk: Some unread tables may still need retention review.
decisions.assumption: Only tables without retention obligation are removed.

decisions.title: Skip unchanged nightly builds
decisions.risk: Low risk; only no-change runs are skipped.
decisions.assumption: Change detection is reliable enough.

decisions.title: Skip builds and move to Zurich
decisions.risk: Migration needs release timing and owner approval.
decisions.assumption: Build behavior stays unchanged except region.

decisions.title: Generate reports on request
decisions.risk: May affect reporting habits and expectations.
decisions.assumption: Requests cover only truly needed reports.

decisions.title: Shorten log retention
decisions.risk: Compliance and troubleshooting needs must be checked.
decisions.assumption: Only services allowed to shorten retention are changed.

extra_measures.title: Small model for manual questions
extra_measures.description: Default ai-assistant manual questions to the small model.
extra_measures.risk: May reduce answer quality for complex queries.
extra_measures.assumption: Escalation to large model stays available.

extra_measures.title: Small model for contract review
extra_measures.description: Default ai-assistant contract reviews to the small model.
extra_measures.risk: Legal nuance may need manual review.
extra_measures.assumption: High-risk contracts can still use the large model.

decisions.title: Remove inactive CRM seats
decisions.risk: Some inactive users may need access by quarter-end.
decisions.assumption: Renew at contract end; inactive seats are truly unused.

decisions.title: Remove inactive chat seats
decisions.risk: Occasional users may lose access to chat history.
decisions.assumption: Renewal can trim only confirmed inactive seats.

decisions.title: Remove inactive ChatGPT seats
decisions.risk: A few users may still need AI access occasionally.
decisions.assumption: Most paid seats are unused and removable at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive design seats
decisions.risk: Design handovers may need temporary access reinstatement.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats are spare or redundant.

decisions.title: Remove inactive e-sign seats
decisions.risk: Signing peaks may need extra seats later.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats are not needed for approvals.

decisions.title: Remove inactive knowledge seats
decisions.risk: Some readers may only access content seasonally.
decisions.assumption: Unused seats can be reassigned or dropped.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Copilot seats
decisions.risk: Executive or project spikes may need quick reactivation.
decisions.assumption: Inactive users are not using Copilot in practice.

decisions.title: Remove inactive note seats
decisions.risk: Meeting-heavy periods may briefly need extra seats.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats are not business-critical.

decisions.title: Remove inactive PM seats
decisions.risk: Project leads may need access during resourcing changes.
decisions.assumption: Only confirmed inactive seats are removed.

decisions.title: Remove inactive scheduling seats
decisions.risk: Scheduling coverage may temporarily drop during absences.
decisions.assumption: Renewal allows trimming unused seats safely.

decisions.title: Remove inactive survey seats
decisions.risk: Rare campaign users may need access later.
decisions.assumption: Most purchased seats are nonessential and removable.

decisions.title: Remove inactive ticket seats
decisions.risk: Support coverage may need a small buffer.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats are unused and can be dropped.

decisions.title: Remove inactive conferencing seats
decisions.risk: Temporary external meetings may need extra licenses.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats are not required for normal operations.

ai_footprint.formula: eq = output (incl. reasoning) + 0.1 × uncached input + 0.01 × cached input (× 0.25 small models); kWh = eq / 1000 × Wh per 1000 tokens (factors.yaml ai_tokens: 0.1 / 0.5 / 2.0); CO2 = kWh × EU grid (0.150 / 0.213 / 0.300 kg/kWh)
ai_footprint.source: measured during this run (token usage returned by the API)
